build_flash_attention_3: build the flash_attn_3 CUDA extension with environment flags to disable backward, split, pagedkv, fp16, fp8, varlen, cluster, hdim, and sm80 features
build_flash_attention_3_rocm: build flash_attn_3 using Triton ROCm backend by setting FLASH_ATTENTION_TRITON_AMD_ENABLE to TRUE instead of CUDA
build_flash_attention_3_offline: build flash_attn_3 in offline mode by setting FLASH_ATTENTION_OFFLINE_BUILD to prevent any internet downloads during compilation
build_flash_attention_3_wheel: build a wheel package for flash_attn_3 using CachedWheelsCommand that attempts to download a prebuilt wheel before falling back to source build
build_flash_attention_3_config: build the flash_attn_config.py file with DISABLE_BACKWARD, DISABLE_SPLIT, DISABLE_PAGEDKV, DISABLE_FP16, DISABLE_FP8, and other feature flags
